Q: Is $149 for an single-paged website in LA worth it? A:

Totally depends on what they offer and how this fits your expectations. These days a website can be created in minutes from scratch with genAI like Lovable by a non-tech person. And then some more if a client wants a specific thing and not just a random one that looks fine. You can try yourself just to be aware of the process and how you can affect it. A company is expected to cut corners at affordable offers, this is the opportunity for them I'd expect to heavily exploit. If you are a satisfied customer, this may still be considered "fair".

if a website is static-only and doesn't need server-side logic like feedback form (this needs to be specifically clarified by a developer) then you can use any cheap hosting, starting from $0 (Cloudflare pages, Netlify), you pay only for domain name.

Q: Why can't GitLab CI/CD access LFS objects from another repository? A:

The solution was to go to CI/CD Settings § Job token permissions and add the davidvandebunte.gitlab.io project. Apparently the LFS endpoint is more restrictive with tokens than the standard git clone endpoint? It's not clear why this would be, but it does fix the problem.

The git lfs -l command was replaced by git lfs ls-files.

Q: Cell title containing formula for transposed data in row A:

see:

=WRAPROWS(TOROW(A2:B, 3, 1), 5)

for labels you can use VSTACK and HSTACK that will never array-error out:

=HSTACK(VSTACK("ROW 1:", "ROW 2:"), WRAPROWS(TOROW(A2:B, 3, 1), 5))

and for 1D array already mentioned TOROW:

=HSTACK("ROW 1:", TOROW(A2:A, 1))

Q: SQLite doesn't see all columns of my table? A:

The problem is with your CREATE_TABLE statement. There should be commas to separate the column definitions. Currently, SQLite interprets this as one column named subjectID with type INTEGERframeworkIDINTEGERscoreInFrameworkINTEGER, which is treated as a custom type. So, the correct code will be:

self.cur.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS analysisResults")
        
self.cur.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS analysisResults(
                    subjectID INTEGER,
                    frameworkID INTEGER,
                    scoreInFramework INTEGER)""")
        
self.cur.execute("""INSERT INTO analysisResults VALUES(1, 1, 1)""")

Q: Why doesn't CMake-generated make clean delete files created with configure_file A:

It seems this may happen if the files are generated under the source folder rather than under the build folder. I think CMake treated the (generated) files it found as source files - or at least, not build files (see @Tsyvarev's comment), so they must not be deleted/altered.
